name: @aum/desktop

scripts.package: bun run build && cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p aum-sidecar && electron-builder --mac

//trustedDependencies: bun blocks lifecycle scripts by default. Without this, electron's postinstall never downloads its binary and `electron-vite dev` fails with the deeply unhelpful 'Error: Electron uninstall'. It must be declared here, in the package that depends on electron — declaring it only at the workspace root is not enough.
